productLaunches.title: NitroStack
productLaunches.description: Build, test, and deploy MCP servers in one place - NitroStack is the full-stack platform for building production-ready MCP servers and AI apps. Build with open-source TypeScript & Python SDKs, test and debug visually in NitroStack Studio, orchestrate agent workflows with NitroStack Workflow, deploy on NitroStack Cloud, and ship branded experiences with NitroStack Chat. Auth, testing, deployment and frontend stay in one workflow. Connect to ChatGPT, Claude and other AI clients. Powering 80,000+ MCP servers.

productLaunches.title: Emochi
productLaunches.description: Voice journal to understand yourself through art and science - Emochi turns your voice notes into a living, generative character that reflects your emotional world. Vent about your day, untangle a thought, or check in with yourself. Your words are transcribed instantly, helping you notice patterns in how you feel. Built by a doctor, a designer, and two AI engineers, Emochi brings affective science and playful art to private, non-clinical self-reflection. Start with a voice note. Meet your Mochi.

productLaunches.title: Notion: Context for your agents
productLaunches.description: Switch AI agents without re-explaining your work - Notion 3.8 turns your workspace into the shared context layer for every AI agent your team uses. Unlike chat tools that start from zero each time you switch models, Notion keeps your docs, databases, and Skills in one place any MCP agent can read and update. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP agent, plug Notion Agents into 150+ tools, sync Skills everywhere with the new Skills API, and see every agent edit in upgraded version history. Plus column permissions and rebuilt synced databases.

productLaunches.title: Craft Agents
productLaunches.description: The world's most powerful agents, with the UX they deserve - Craft Agents is fully open source and runs locally on your machine — your data and keys never leave it. Bring any AI provider: Claude, GPT, Gemini, or local models. Agents connect to your real tools (MCP, APIs, local files) and act across all of them. Code diffs, data tables, diagrams, and live previews render inline. Turn results into persistent Pages, teach reusable Skills, and run Automations on a schedule — all in a desktop UX you can actually live in.

productLaunches.title: Step 5 Preview
productLaunches.description: 600B open weights, trained for long-running agents - Step 5 Preview is StepFun's open-weight MoE for coding, financial research and long-running agents. It has 600B total parameters, 27B active per token and a 1M-token context, with deployment support for vLLM, SGLang and Transformers.

items.summary: 据彭博社 15 日报道，丹麦最高法院维持对一名 31 岁男子 18 个月监禁的判决，该男子因持有并传播 3.6 万余张 AI 生成的儿童色情图像获刑，且不适用缓刑。法院裁定，即使图像无真实人物原型，也受丹麦《刑法》约束，量刑时不应考虑人物是否虚构；此案为丹麦首起此类定罪，并引发跨国调查，警方查明 273 名买家身份、逮捕 25 人。

sourceItems.description: The world's most powerful agents, with the UX they deserve - Craft Agents is fully open source and runs locally on your machine — your data and keys never leave it. Code diffs, data tables, diagrams, and live previews render inline. Turn results into persistent Pages, teach reusable Skills, and run Automations on a schedule — all in a desktop UX you can actually live in.
